title: Walsh characters square to one
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S \subseteq [n]$, and let $x \in \{0,1\}^n$ be a point of the Boolean hypercube. Then the Walsh--Fourier character $\chi_S$ satisfies $\chi_S(x)^2 = 1$; that is, every character takes values in $\{-1, 1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: x is a point of the Boolean hypercube {0,1}^n
